title: Image Path Preview
description: Preview image paths while browsing autocomplete or hovering over code in VS Code and compatible editors.

title: Globw
description: Syntax colors, run button, live errors, completion, hover and formatting for the Globw language (.gw)

title: Calamo Sheet Music Scanner
description: Optical music recognition (OMR) for Lily#: reads a page image or PDF of printed sheet music into editable Lily# (.lys) text, with the uncertain places marked. Open source (Apache-2.0). Adds to the Lily# extension; runs locally on Windows.

title: Cantoria Singing Voice
description: Sings the lyrics of a score for notation extensions such as Lily#: notes with syllables in, a voice out, through DiffSinger voices in the OpenUtau format, or your own NEUTRINO or VOICEVOX. Voices from different engines can sing together. Open source (Apache-2.0); runs locally.
